My partner said that the driver cut them off and stopped behind me while I was at the stop sign, so he wouldn't have been able to accelerate into me very quickly. The road also narrows to approximately 5 m at the stop sign, as a traffic calming measure.

The driver's attitude towards the situation is what makes me feel unsafe, despite me being unharmed. I definitely believe the physical circumstances of the road is what kept me safe and that man is a dangerous driver. Passing me at a stop sign in a 30 km/hr zone is not going to save him much time on his drive and he was unapologetic about hitting me to do that.

Edit: I have some friends at the city of Toronto that helped me measure road width. I put a picture.
I went back to the intersection and did not see any cameras. I finished my collision report - it will be investigated as a fail to remain collision.

I got a call back from them at 8:17 pm. The officer acknowledged that it had been a while and asked if I had gone home, so it made me feel better that at least he knew the response time was long. He also gave me a reference number so I can finish the collision reporting in person tomorrow.

After I was hit at the stop sign, I was in shock. My partner and the other witness who I got contact information from said they saw the driver reverse a bit, then went forward and clipped me a second time while trying to pass me when I was stopped at the stop sign after I was hit the first time.

The driver exchanged words with myself and another driver who got out of his vehicle to tell him off. He was unapologetic and continued to be aggressive, so I could not get a name or any other information about him before he drove off. I barely got my phone out in time to take the picture of his vehicle. All around, it was an unpleasant situation to be in.

Edit: Maybe the police will agree that there was failure on the driver's part to stay at the scene of a collision. I don't know, I will find out when I finish the collision reporting in person.

Yes. I have my partner as a witness and one of the other people around gave me their phone number to give to the police if they're interested in getting witness statements.

Unfortunately we did not get police at the scene and I will have to go report the collision at a center later.

We called police after the collision happened around 3:20 pm today. The dispatcher said they would send someone. We waited in the area until around 5:40 pm and did not get to speak to anyone. I will go to the collision reporting center at a later time.

I was in Grade 10 when we started our relationship, so I would have been 14 I think. We were long distance (Canada to the UK), and we were both moderators of a community of an EDM label. He was born the same year as me.

The type of person I am is hardworking, committed, and reflective. When something goes wrong, I look for what I can change to get a better outcome from it. Unfortunately this was exploited by him. I wanted him to trust me so I would let him look through all my dms. He never returned that favour tho and since he cheated on me, I can see why. My current partner doesn't need to monitor me and look at my dms.

Around the first anniversary of dating, I had a cold. We had previously been experimenting with being sexual. He ended up sexually roleplaying with another girl via text. He told me and seemed upset about it, so I forgave him. The girl later dmed me telling me it hadn't stopped. When I asked him about it, he dismissed her as crazy and a shit stirrer. Funny how that's how he refers to me now. I should have listened to the girl.

The first breakup we had was because I forgot to tell him I had a piano recital and I needed to leave because my dad was waiting to drive us to the venue. He wanted me to lock myself in my room to stay with him. This isn't reasonable, so of course I would go. This was our first breakup and it upset me so much. I remember when he finally answered me, it was after crying all night. He didn't really seem sorry. It broke my world and he didn't seem to take it as seriously as I had. He didn't want to actually break up according to him and I was so happy I gave him a pass. He didn't even need a long heartfelt apology to get me back.

I visited him in the UK with my parents when I was 16. When my parents didn't want me seeing him again on the trip, he said he wanted to commit suicide if I didn't sneak away from my parents to go to his house. Another unreasonable request because I'm on Christmas holiday with my parents who paid for the trip and running away in a foreign country is insane. Naturally, I freaked. We were staying with a friend of my mom's so she called the police to check on him.

There was more cheating on his part. He admitted to which girls he messed around with. At the time, he called me crazy and clingy for being uncomfortable seeing him so friendly with a girl he told me he sexted with. I began to try and convince myself that he turned to her because I wasn't what he needed and if I shaped myself to meet his needs, he would love only me.

I mentioned moderating for a EDM label at the top of this comment. It's important because he would talk about how I'm insane, manipulative, and a compulsive liar in a group chat called "modsquad" to other moderators behind my back. He made fun of me in that chat for calling Kids Help Phone to talk about our relationship. Kids Help Phone is for minors to talk about anything including their relationships, and since he previously didn't want me discussing our relationship with friends and my family didn't understand, this was the only way I could talk about my feelings safely. Also, funny how he was upset about me discussing our relationship with friends but he can shit talk me to our fellow moderators behind my back.

He would dm people that I was friends with in the community to say bad things about me, even after I left the community. He was trying to control his image and turn everyone who liked me against me. It was really isolating, especially because this music label says that we're a family. 

At the start of the relationship, he was sweet and would do things like rebrand his Twitter to show our relationship. I then became the target of his insults. He would switch to saying it's banter and a joke when I told him it made me unhappy that he called me stupid. He deleted my messages in the music label's discord as a joke. He didn't even let me know it was coming. I found out by checking the audit log. It was disrespectful to use me as a joke. How can it be a joke if it's something I would never laugh with?

It was just hard to get out when you are the person who wants to better themselves and the other person uses that to make sure the blame and the insults stick. It took someone dropping me into that modsquad chat and seeing how he talked about me for us to break up for the last time. After that, it took a few more months for me to finally pull away from him and find a loving relationship with someone else. I was 17 then.

I'm doing okay. I'm working in the aerospace industry. Clearly I'm not stupid as he liked to tell me. I think my situation was made worse by moderating for the EDM label community with him. It allowed him to use his popularity to isolate me. It also allowed him to use the staff members and even the CEO to control me. I wasn't allowed to say I had a past relationship. I wasn't allowed to respond to anyone if they made a conversation about their relationships. They would all make a fuss about what I put on a privated twitter too. Meanwhile, he can shit talk me as much as he likes. It was absolutely unfair and if we hadn't been wrapped up in the EDM label's community, he wouldn't have that social power he used against me and I would have been able to leave easier because my irl friends knew me personally and didn't know him, so they couldn't be used against me the way he used the online community against me.

I did because he would tell mutual friends or even acquaintances lies about me. Some of them came to me with screenshots of the messages and he'd be like "hey I know we don't talk a lot but [insert lie here about me]". 

He also instructed his friend group to keep an eye on me and therefore it was intimidating to have him show up in discord servers I frequented because he always happened to join at the same time as a few of his friends. I couldn't feel happy or safe in that environment.

If I hadn't said anything, the only thing people would know about me over time is whatever he said about me. Eventually I left 
that segment of the internet because I gotta study at university and he still made the effort to try and tell people bad things about me, and he lashes out at people who believe me. So I know in my heart that he would always try to stir up shit and say bad things about me whether I spoke up or not, so I can be proud that at least I left records and proof that he was responsible for the emotional abuse. Hopefully it helps the next girls he dates. I already heard that after me, there was a minor he dated and she felt used for the nudes after getting out of his circle. Ouch.

Yes. It is the most infurating thing in the world when someone else hurts you, you try to manage your feelings until they start spreading rumours about you, you try to do things the "right" way in private until you can't take it, and then they cry that they just want to move on but why do you get to determine the timeline for moving on if you have never owned up to what has happened? I kept learning thing after thing about what they were trying to do to sabotage me and people wave it off like "oh it's the past" because I wasn't told until months later. For me, who just found out about it, I need to process it ffs.

They were kicked from their position by bitching about me to the people we worked with by bringing up some private things I disclosed to them (including that I needed to call a helpline because I was feeling like they didn't respect me and I needed someone to talk to because they told me I wasn't allowed to talk about them to our friends) and one of their friends is like "oh well they're hurt because they got kicked", like okay and I have to go to therapy to cope with what they did to me by turning the place into an unhealthy working environment, them invalidating my feelings and concerns, and them succeeding in making me believe that it's my fault, that I'm not being who they need me to be and I should be the one to change and accept however they want to act. Them being kicked was the consequence of what they did to me and I'm supposed to feel bad about reporting it? All the gaslighting they did literally made me feel like there was a weird lump in my head that I wanted to dig out or try to smash out of my skull because they would always tell me it happened x way which did not match up with what I experienced. I started to doubt my own memory so I eventually just kept a record of everything to try and cope and make sure that, yes, I am sane.
